body.message:
As per your request, please find below the rates for a 3-month stay at Miraclz Tower by Danube:

September: AED 8,800
October: AED 10,500
November: AED 12,500

Please note that each booking will be arranged for a minimum of 30 nights.

A refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 will also be required. The deposit will be fully refunded at check-out, provided there are no damages or outstanding charges related to the apartment. The refund will be processed within 7 working days following your departure.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you with the booking arrangements.
